arxiv-2004-07521.creator: Domna Chiotaki, Kostas Karpouzis
arxiv-2004-07521.description: Abstract . Educators often seek ways to introduce gaming in the classroom in order to break the usual teaching routine, expand the usual course curriculum with additional knowledge, but mostly as a means to motivate students and increase their engagement with the course content.

arxiv-2102-11028.title: Automated real-time spectral characterization of phase-change tunable optical filters using a linear variable filter and infrared camera
arxiv-2102-11028.creator: David Bombara, Calum Williams, Stephen Borg, Hyun Jung Kim
arxiv-2102-11028.description: Abstract Actively tunable optical filters based on chalcogenide phase-change materials (PCMs) are an emerging technology with applications across chemical spectroscopy and thermal imaging. The refractive index of an embedded PCM thin film is modulated through an amorphous-to-crystalline phase transition induced through thermal stimulus.

arxiv-2104-10205.title: On the relation between Preference Reversal and Strategy-Proofness Thanks: Corresponding author.
arxiv-2104-10205.creator: K. P. S. Bhaskara Rao
arxiv-2104-10205.description: Abstract We analyze the relation between strategy-proofness and preference reversal in the case that agents may declare indifference. Interestingly, Berga and Moreno (2020), have recently derived preference reversal from group strategy-proofness of social choice functions on strict preferences domains if the range has no more than three elements. We extend this result and at the same time simplify it.

arxiv-2204-06407.title: Flexible Multiple-Objective Reinforcement Learning for Chip Placement Conference: Design Automation Conference 2022; July 10–14, 2022; San Francisco, CA
arxiv-2204-06407.creator: Fu-Chieh Chang 1,3 , Yu-Wei Tseng 2 , Ya-Wen Yu 2 , Ssu-Rui Lee 2 , Alexandru Cioba 1 , I-Lun Tseng 2 , Da-shan Shiu 1 , Jhih-Wei Hsu 3 , Cheng-Yuan Wang 3 , Chien-Yi Yang 3 , Ren-Chu Wang 3 , Yao-Wen Chang 3 , Tai-Chen Chen 4 and Tung-Chieh Chen 4
arxiv-2204-06407.description: Abstract . Recently, successful applications of reinforcement learning to chip placement have emerged. Pretrained models are necessary to improve efficiency and effectiveness. Currently, the weights of objective metrics (e.g., wirelength, congestion, and timing) are fixed during pretraining. However, fixed-weighed models cannot generate the diversity of placements required for engineers to accommodate changing requirements as they arise.

arxiv-2304-04927.title: Data-Driven Fast Frequency Control using Inverter-Based Resources
arxiv-2304-04927.creator: Etinosa Ekomwenrenren, John W. Simpson-Porco, Evangelos Farantatos, Mahendra Patel, Aboutaleb Haddadi, and Lin Zhu
arxiv-2304-04927.description: Abstract To address the control challenges associated with the increasing share of inverter-connected renewable energy resources, this paper proposes a direct data-driven approach for fast frequency control in the bulk power system. The proposed control scheme partitions the power system into control areas, and leverages local dispatchable inverter-based resources to rapidly mitigate local power imbalances upon events.

arxiv-2410-22710.title: LoFLAT: Local Feature Matching using Focused Linear Attention Transformer
arxiv-2410-22710.creator: \authorblockN Naijian Cao, Renjie He ∗ , Yuchao Dai, and Mingyi He \authorblockA Northwestern Polytechnical University, Xian, China E-mail: caonaijian@mail.nwpu.edu.cn, {davidhrj; daiyuchao; myhe}@nwpu.edu.cn
arxiv-2410-22710.description: Abstract Local feature matching is an essential technique in image matching and plays a critical role in a wide range of vision-based applications. However, existing Transformer-based detector-free local feature matching methods encounter challenges due to the quadratic computational complexity of attention mechanisms, especially at high resolutions.

arxiv-2411-05374.title: Interdisciplinary Translations: Sensory Perception as a Universal Language
arxiv-2411-05374.creator: Xindi Kang, Xuanyang Huang, Mingdong Song, Varvara Guljajeva, JoAnn Kuchera-Morin
arxiv-2411-05374.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Xindi Kang, Xuanyang Huang, Mingdong Song, Varvara Guljajeva, JoAnn Kuchera-Morin. This paper investigates sensory perception’s pivotal role as a universal communicative bridge across varied cultures and disciplines, and how it manifests its value in the study of media art, human computer interaction and artificial intelligence.

arxiv-2412-16913.title: Tilt stability of a class of nonlinear semidefinite programs
arxiv-2412-16913.creator: Yulan Liu, Shaohua Pan and Shujun Bi
arxiv-2412-16913.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Yulan Liu, Shaohua Pan and Shujun Bi. This paper concerns the tilt stability of local optimal solutions to a class of nonlinear semidefinite programs, which involves a twice continuously differentiable objective function and a convex feasible set.

arxiv-2501-17779.title: FFT-based Alignment of 2d Closed Curves with Application to Elastic Shape Analysis
arxiv-2501-17779.creator: Günay Dogan, Javier Bernal, Charles Hagwood
arxiv-2501-17779.description: Abstract For many shape analysis problems in computer vision and scientific imaging ( e.g. , computational anatomy, morphological cytometry), the ability to align two closed curves in the plane is crucial. In this paper, we concentrate on rigidly aligning pairs of closed curves in the plane.

arxiv-2504-15897.title: SUPRA: Subspace Parameterized Attention for Neural Operator on General Domains
arxiv-2504-15897.creator: Zherui Yang, Zhengyang Xue, Ligang Liu
arxiv-2504-15897.description: Abstract Neural operators are efficient surrogate models for solving partial differential equations (PDEs), but their key components face challenges: (1) in order to improve accuracy, attention mechanisms suffer from computational inefficiency on large-scale meshes, and (2) spectral convolutions rely on the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) on regular grids and assume a flat geometry, which causes accuracy degradation on irregular domains.

arxiv-2512-09398.title: Towards Resilient Transportation: A Conditional Transformer for Accident-Informed Traffic Forecasting Conference: Proceedings of the 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference on Knowledge Discovery and Data Mining V.1; August 09–13, 2026; Jeju Island, Republic of Korea Proceedings of the 32nd ACM SIGKDD Conference
arxiv-2512-09398.creator: Hongjun Wang, Jiawei Yong, Jiawei Wang, Shintaro Fukushima, Renhe Jiang
arxiv-2512-09398.description: Abstract . Traffic prediction remains a key challenge in spatio-temporal data mining, despite progress in deep learning. Accurate forecasting is hindered by the complex influence of external factors such as traffic accidents and regulations, often overlooked by existing models due to limited data integration.

pmc-10638828.title: Prediction factors and clinical significance of different types of hemorrhagic transformation after intravenous thrombolysis
pmc-10638828.creator: Yanan Hao, Huan Zhou, Chengzhen Pan, Guomin Xie, Jin Hu, Bing Zhang, Shuxia Qian, Shenqiang Yan, the CASE II investigators
pmc-10638828.description: Background and purposeHemorrhagic transformation (HT) after intravenous thrombolysis (IVT) in acute ischemic stroke seriously affects the prognosis of patients. This study aimed to investigate the risk factors of different types of HT and their correlation with prognosis after IVT.MethodsBased on the CASE II registry, we included patients with acute ischemic stroke who received IVT within 4.5 h of onset.

pmc-11424516.title: Unraveling monoclonal gammopathy of renal significance: a mini review on kidney complications and clinical insights
pmc-11424516.creator: Mythri Shankar, Manjusha Yadla
pmc-11424516.description: Monoclonal gammopathy of renal significance (MGRS) is where kidney injury occurs due to the accumulation or effects of abnormal monoclonal proteins. These proteins, originating from non-cancerous or pre-cancerous plasma cells or B cells, deposit in specific areas of the kidney.

pmc-11476252.title: Enhancing the Efficacy of Breast Cancer Immunotherapy Using a Smac-Armed Oncolytic Virus
pmc-11476252.creator: Sijia Tang, Kristin V Lyles, Yuzhen Wang, Daping Fan, Ming Luo, Louisa Chard Dunmall
pmc-11476252.description: Simple SummaryImmune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) are the most recent breakthrough in cancer treatments. Several drugs have been approved by the FDA including anti-PD-1 antibodies (Nivolumab, Pembrolizumab, and Cemiplimab). Their treatment is most effective for melanoma, non-small cell lung cancer, or bladder cancer.

pmc-11614614.title: Association between a novel inflammation-lipid composite marker CRP/HDL and erectile dysfunction: evidence from a large national cross-sectional study
pmc-11614614.creator: Yangyang Mei, Yiming Chen, Bo Zhang, Wei Xia, Naiyuan Shao, Xingliang Feng
pmc-11614614.description: BackgroundErectile dysfunction (ED) is one of the most common male sexual disorders, closely associated with both inflammation and lipid dysregulation. Recently, a novel inflammation-lipid composite marker, CRP/HDL, has been proposed to integrate the impact of both pathways on health, yet its relationship with ED remains unexplored.

pmc-13311933.creator: Georgina Krebs, Elizabeth Hogg

pmc-13342573.title: Differential oxidation of surimi actomyosin by malondialdehyde and heme: spectroscopy and molecular simulation
pmc-13342573.creator: Hao Zhu, Qingchun Zhang, Benjamin K Simpson, Yanbo Wang, Yicheng Ding, Shulai Liu, Shichen Zhu, Xuxia Zhou
pmc-13342573.description: Pro-oxidative factors compromise surimi gel quality by inducing protein denaturation and aggregation. This study elucidated the interactions between malondialdehyde (MDA) and hemin with surimi actomyosin through multispectral analysis and molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. The results suggested that MDA and hemin induced actomyosin oxidation by altering protein conformation, surface hydrophobicity, and the microenvironment of aromatic residues, especially under low-pH/high-temperature conditions.

pmc-13506489.title: Who is placed, heard, and seen? Gendered opportunity pathways in Ghanaian senior high school choirs and marching bands
pmc-13506489.creator: John-Doe Dordzro
pmc-13506489.description: Choirs and marching bands are important sites of musical learning, school representation, and youth leadership in Ghanaian senior high schools. Yet little is known about how gendered opportunity structures shape students’ access to instruments and roles, rehearsal experiences, leadership opportunities, and psychosocial participation.
